fee_notes: Royalty is a flat monthly fee of $1,250 (not a % of Gross Sales), increasing $50/month on each 1-year anniversary of the Franchise Agreement effective date. Brand Development Fund not currently assessed; if implemented, capped at $350/month. Local Advertising Requirement not currently assessed; if implemented, capped at 2% of Gross Sales/month. Technology Fee is $165/month per Gym. Third-party Required Software includes $249/month for payment processing/POS (paid to third-party supplier, not franchisor). Renewal Fee: $2,500. Transfer Fee: $5,000 (FA) or $5,000 per undeveloped franchise (ADA).
raw_excerpt:
Royalties (or "Royalty Fees") | $1,250 per month, with a $50 per month increase upon each one (1) year anniversary of the effective date of the Franchise Agreement. | Currently, on or before the day we designate each calendar month based on the Gross Sales generated during the preceding calendar month | We may change the interval at which we collect these Royalty Fees upon 30 days' prior written notice via the Manual(s) or otherwise.

Brand Development Fund (the "Fund") Contribution | Not currently assessed. | If established, at the same time and in the same manner as your Royalty Fees. | We do not currently require that franchisees make contributions to our Brand Development Fund. We reserve the right to require franchisees to contribute to the Brand Development Fund, upon 30 days' written notice; if we implement such a requirement, the amount of such required contribution will not exceed $350 per month.

Local Advertising Requirement (LAR) | Not currently assessed. | If required, this expenditure must be made monthly based on the Gross Sales generated in the preceding calendar month | amount of the LAR will not exceed 2% of Gross Sales per month.

Technology Fee | $165 per month (per Gym) | As agreed. | As of the Issue Date, we provide access to certain technology and related services necessary to operate your Franchised Business in accordance with our current System, and we charge a Technology Fee to help defray the costs and expenses associated with the same.

Third-Party Required Software | $249/month for payment processing and other POS-related services, plus any additional merchant processing charges. | As invoiced or otherwise agreed with our then-current Approved Supplier(s). | none of these amounts are paid to us or our affiliate.
